???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What is one call's entry on the call stack, holding its parameters, local variables and return place, called?"

        A stack frame.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).

    ??? question "What does every token, tree node and error message carry to say exactly which stretch of source it came from?"

        A source span, a start position and a length.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 1. Source text and error messages](../compiler/guide/stage-1-source-and-diagnostics.md). Specification: [1. Conformance and terminology](../specification/conformance.md#17-source-locations).

    ??? question "What records the calls that have started but not yet finished, adding one on each call and removing one on each return?"

        The call stack.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).
